_doc: Shared topic taxonomy for the cross-company attention map. Each topic has a plain-English definition (used for blind validation) and case-insensitive regex keywords (used by attention.py). Multi-label: an article can carry several topics.

credit.label: Credit & corporate bonds
credit.definition: Corporate, high-yield, EM, municipal and convertible bonds; credit trading protocols (RFQ, all-to-all, portfolio trading); CDS on single names or indices when discussed as credit trading.

rates.label: Rates, government bonds, repo & money markets
rates.definition: Treasuries, gilts, Bunds and other sovereign debt; repo; money market funds and T-bills; agency/TBA mortgages as a traded rates product; SOFR/LIBOR as rates.

derivs_clearing.label: Derivatives, futures & clearing
derivs_clearing.definition: Swaps, swaptions, futures and options as products; central clearing houses (LCH, ICE Clear, OCC), margin, compression; swap execution facilities.

equities_etf.label: Equities & ETFs
equities_etf.definition: Cash equities, stock exchanges' equity trading, ETFs and ETF trading, iShares as an ETF business.

commodities_energy.label: Commodities & energy
commodities_energy.definition: Oil, gas, power, metals, agriculture, carbon/emissions markets, and benchmarks for them (Brent, TTF, Platts).

mortgage_lending.label: Mortgages & lending technology
mortgage_lending.definition: Mortgage origination and servicing technology, loan data, residential lending, consumer and commercial lending as a business line.

listings_ipo.label: Listings, IPOs & primary markets
listings_ipo.definition: Exchange listings, IPOs, issuer services, new-issue bond primary markets, capital raising on exchanges.

indices_benchmarks.label: Indices & benchmarks
indices_benchmarks.definition: Index families and index licensing (S&P 500, FTSE Russell, iBoxx, Bloomberg Agg, ICE BofA), benchmark administration, reference rates and closing prices used as benchmarks.

pricing_data.label: Pricing, reference data & analytics
pricing_data.definition: Evaluated pricing (BVAL, CP+, Ai-Price, ICE CEP, S&P evaluations), reference data, market data feeds and licensing, analytics, ratings data, research data products.

workflow_desktop.label: Workflow software, desktops & buy-side tech
workflow_desktop.definition: Terminals and desktops (Bloomberg Terminal, Workspace, Eikon), order/execution management systems, Aladdin, portfolio and risk software, APIs and integrations sold as software.

electronification.label: Electronic trading & automation
electronification.definition: Moving trading from voice to electronic, trading protocols, automation and rules-based execution (AiEX, Auto-X), algos, streaming prices, liquidity and market structure of trading venues.

ai.label: AI & machine learning
ai.definition: Artificial intelligence, machine learning, LLMs and generative AI, AI assistants and agents, AI governance, as products or internal tools.

digital_assets.label: Digital assets, crypto & tokenization
digital_assets.definition: Crypto, stablecoins, tokenized securities and funds, blockchain/DLT, on-chain settlement, deposit tokens, prediction markets.

private_markets.label: Private markets & private credit
private_markets.definition: Private equity, private credit, infrastructure, alternatives, private-company data (Preqin, PitchBook-like), private markets trading.

esg_climate.label: Sustainability, ESG & climate
esg_climate.definition: ESG, sustainability, climate risk and transition, net zero, stewardship and proxy voting on ESG, sustainable finance products.

regulation_policy.label: Regulation & public policy
regulation_policy.definition: Regulators and rules (SEC, CFTC, FINRA, FCA, ESMA, Basel, MiFID, EMIR), policy positions, consultations, mandates, lobbying, government relations.

deals_capital.label: M&A, results & capital return
deals_capital.definition: Acquisitions, divestitures, mergers, earnings results, guidance, dividends, buybacks, debt raising, investor days.

people_culture.label: People, leadership & culture
people_culture.definition: Executive appointments and departures, succession, board changes, employees, culture, talent, diversity programmes, workplace.

fees_pricing_power.label: Fees, pricing power & costs
fees_pricing_power.definition: What the company charges and earns per unit: fee rates, fee per million, price increases or cuts, take rates, client cost savings, the company's own cost cuts and expense synergies.

risk_resilience.label: Operational risk, cyber & resilience
risk_resilience.definition: Cybersecurity, outages, operational resilience, business continuity, fraud, data breaches, systemic risk and market stress handling by the company itself.

international.label: International & emerging-market expansion
international.definition: Expansion into specific countries/regions, China, Asia-Pacific, Middle East, Latin America, EM access programmes, local-market licences.

retail_wealth.label: Retail, wealth & consumer
retail_wealth.definition: Retail investors and advisors, wealth management, consumer banking and cards, retirement savers, mass-market products.

payments_banking.label: Payments, treasury & transaction banking
payments_banking.definition: Payments, cash management, corporate treasury services, deposits, FX payments, transaction banking.

ratings_research.label: Credit ratings & research
ratings_research.definition: Credit ratings and ratings agencies as a business, sell-side or house research publications and economic outlooks.
